{{Monster Infobox |title = Bully Rex |images = Bully Rex Anim.gif |location = [[Highlands]] |drops = ''See loot table'' |hp = 13000 |dmg = 135 |def = 7 |speed = 2 |XP = 7 }} '''Bully Rex''', based on the [[Stardew:Pepper Rex|Pepper Rex]], is a boss-level monster found in the [[Highlands]]. It has an absurdly high amount of health points and can be found at the peak of the northwest mountain. Defeating the Bully Rex yields a [[Golden Key]] required to free the [[Highlands Dwarf]] in the [[Highlands Cavern]]. Only one may spawn per in-game day. == Strategy == Bully Rex pauses its movement and continually belches flames in one direction when attacking. Use this time to sidestep the fire and begin attacking it. During the pause in movement before its attack, Bully Rex can quickly turn around if the player moves to its side too quickly. The best strategy to counter this is to stand diagonally next to Bully Rex until it begins its attack, and then attacking the side it is not shooting from. {{Info|For clarity on vanilla Pepper Rex behavior, see [[Stardew:Pepper Rex|Stardew Valley wiki - Pepper Rex]]}} ==Loot Drops== {{LootDropsTable|Title=Bully Rex}} | rowspan="6" | [[Highlands]] | {{Name|Golden Key}} || 1
